card.name: Scattered connecting words in sentences
card.fires_on: No single word or setting is shared. It marks odd spots such as 'to' after 'was', 'we' after 'this chapter', 'accent' in 'accentuate', and the decimal point in section numbers.

modes.label: Linking word in the middle of a sentence
modes.description: A small word such as 'to', 'we', 'such' or 'the' where the sentence is still unfolding.
modes.example: In this chapter<< we>> will discuss the details of the client/server

modes.label: Partway through a word or number
modes.description: A piece inside a longer word or a section number, such as 'accent' in accentuate or the dot in 5.1.

card.plain: No steady pattern was found; it responds to unrelated small words and parts of words.
